digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Pakia (2005) App. VI

teaser.en: A 'whip of sacred powers': a stick of this tree is said to punish offenders and open closed homes and graves.
teaser.sw: 'Mjeledi wa nguvu takatifu': inasemekana fimbo ya mti huu huwaadhibu wakosaji na kufungua nyumba na makaburi yaliyofungwa.

summary.en: *Mlangalangazuka* is a tree of coastal thicket and woodland with large orange-red trumpet flowers and long ribbed pods. A stick of it is used as a magical whip, to punish offenders or open closed places.
summary.sw: *Mlangalangazuka* ni mti wa vichaka vizito na misitu ya wazi ya pwani wenye maua makubwa ya rangi ya chungwa-nyekundu yenye umbo la tarumbeta na maganda marefu yenye mistari ya mbavu. Fimbo yake hutumika kama mjeledi wa uchawi, kuwaadhibu wakosaji au kufungua mahali palipofungwa.

about.en: *Mlangalangazuka* is a striking tree when in flower. Large, tubular blooms of orange-red stand out against pinnate leaves. Long, ribbed pods follow the flowers. It belongs to the trumpet-flower family, together with the sausage tree.
about.sw: *Mlangalangazuka* ni mti wa kuvutia sana unapochanua. Maua makubwa yenye umbo la mrija ya rangi ya chungwa-nyekundu hujitokeza wazi dhidi ya majani yenye vijani vilivyopangwa kama unyoya. Baada ya maua huja maganda marefu yenye mistari ya mbavu. Ni wa familia ya maua-tarumbeta, pamoja na mvungunya.

where.en: It grows in coastal thicket and woodland.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vizito na misitu ya wazi ya pwani.

uses.en: A stick of *mlangalangazuka* is used as a magical whip.
uses.sw: Fimbo ya *mlangalangazuka* hutumika kama mjeledi wa uchawi.

culture.en: Pakia explains the name as 'whip of sacred powers'. The stick is used to punish offenders, and to open closed places, such as homes and graves, by whipping them magically. It is one of a small set of Digo whipping plants, along with *mlanga*, whose name simply means 'whip'.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza jina hili kuwa ni 'mjeledi wa nguvu takatifu'. Fimbo hii hutumika kuwaadhibu wakosaji, na kufungua mahali palipofungwa, kama nyumba na makaburi, kwa kupachapa kichawi. Ni mmojawapo wa kundi dogo la mimea ya Kidigo ya kuchapia, pamoja na *mlanga*, ambalo jina lake lina maana ya 'mjeledi' tu.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mlangalangazuka*, 'whip of sacred powers'. The Mgombato dictionary lists *mulanga* for this plant, *Fernandoa magnifica*, with the Swahili name *mbomba mweupe*. No English name is in common use.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mlangalangazuka*, 'mjeledi wa nguvu takatifu'. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaorodhesha *mulanga* kwa mmea huu, *Fernandoa magnifica*, pamoja na jina la Kiswahili *mbomba mweupe*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza linalotumika kwa kawaida.

reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa mjeledi wa uchawi

reason.en: Sausage tree, in the same trumpet-flower family
reason.sw: Mvungunya, wa familia moja ya maua-tarumbeta
Jamaa mwenye maua yenye umbo la tarumbeta
Jamaa wa vichakani mwenye maua yenye umbo la tarumbeta
